reason: The cited evidence does not directly support the proposed synergistic Cr-Ti-Al scale or its adhesion mechanisms in the specific alloy. E1 shows layered oxides in a different alloy at 400 °C, E2 demonstrates adhesion improvement via Y in other alloys, E4 and E5 discuss stress-induced cracking and reactive element effects in Nb-Si-Ti-Al-Hf alloys, and E3 addresses Cr effects on mechanical properties, not oxidation. None of the key premises are grounded in the cited passages.
premises: Synergistic Cr, Ti, and minor Al oxidation forms a protective, adherent oxide scale
Thermal stress near ~800 °C causes scale spallation, accelerating degradation
